user.title: Skridsko ice observations – login
user.description:
The integration regularly checks your interest area on tur.skridsko.net for new ice observations and forwards them with images and map.

PHPSESSID: log in to tur.skridsko.net in Chrome → F12 → Application → Cookies → tur.skridsko.net.

data.push_only_skateable: Only push when ice is reported skateable
data.use_email: Also react instantly to Skridsko alert emails (optional)

data_description.email_to: Empty = recipient configured in the notify service.
data_description.email_service: E.g. an SMTP notify service. Images are embedded.
data_description.keepalive_min: Each check is one view of the observation list, which both finds new observations and keeps the login alive. New random delay between shortest and longest, plus up to 40 seconds.
data_description.smtp_user: Only used with built-in Gmail sending. Create an app password at myaccount.google.com → Security → App passwords.
data_description.include_map: Map image from Kartverket with a marker, plus links to Norgeskart and Google Maps.
data_description.use_email: Without email, new observations arrive with the next check (max ~20 min). With email they arrive within seconds. Requires the IMAP integration.

reauth_confirm.title: Skridsko login has expired
reauth_confirm.description: Log in to tur.skridsko.net again and paste the new key. {pending} alert(s) are queued and will be sent once login works.

error.invalid_auth: The key does not give access. Log in to tur.skridsko.net and copy PHPSESSID again.
error.email_service_required: Choose a notify service for email.
error.max_below_min: Longest interval must be at least the shortest.
error.smtp_incomplete: Fill in Gmail account, app password and recipient for built-in sending.
error.imap_required: Choose the mailbox, or turn off email alerts.

abort.no_imap: Set up the IMAP integration for the mailbox receiving Skridsko alerts first.
